optionalFlags.--root <dir>: canonicalized via realpath; must be a directory
optionalFlags.--file <rel>: registry path relative to root; absolute paths, backslashes, NUL, drive letters and UNC prefixes rejected (unsafe_registry_path, exit 2)
optionalFlags.--since <ISO-date>: opened must additionally be >= this date
optionalFlags.--self-test: writes only to mkdtemp dirs; clean 26/26 observed 2026-10-20

hardLineRequirements: registry must be a regular file, not a symlink (O_NOFOLLOW + realpath identity); valid UTF-8 (fatal decoder)
file must contain all four trimmed headings at column zero: '## Registry', '## Paths', '## Search log', '## Leads (unopened)' (missing_section)
data rows must sit under '## Registry'; a '## ' heading flips section tracking; rows matching rowPattern elsewhere produce row_outside_registry

fleetCensus.parser: gawk -F'|'; accepts 0-3 leading ASCII spaces before rows/headings; >=4 spaces is indented code and ignored

keyRules: rule 1: a row is a claim — written only after the source is opened this round; lesson Gate records URL, access date, <=25-word located quote
rule 2: append-only — only status, recheck and used-by change in place, logged old->new; a correction is a new row whose teaches opens 'supersedes S0NN —'
rule 4: expansion is knowledge, not rows — no row quota
rule 5: search log one prose note per bounded search
rule 6: no credential material, session/private URLs or op:// references

columnCount.rule: 11 cells => 13 fields when the line is split on '|' (leading and trailing pipe produce empty edge fields); both validators require NF==13 after trim
columnCount.trap: any literal '|' inside a cell inflates the split; markdown tables have no escaping here

id.valuePattern: S[0-9]{3,} (S + 3 or more digits; 'S30' fails, 'S030' and 'S0300' pass)
id.uniqueness: duplicate id => duplicate_id (E03); ids never reused (contract)
id.nonMatchingRowLine: a Registry-section pipe-line whose first cell is not a valid id/header/divider is still a row candidate and yields bad_id

source.shape: <title> — <canonical URL or DOI>; a repo path or command is allowed only for kind=own-work (e.g. S029)

duplicateDetection.gate: first http(s):// match in cell; strip fragment, trailing slash, scheme and leading www.; lowercase host only. Any second row with equal normalized URL => duplicate_url (E04) unless teaches matches /^supersedes S[0-9]{3,}\b/
duplicateDetection.fleet: duplicate URL is scope-sensitive: same URL same scope => E04 (rejected rows exempt unless paired with non-rejected; 'supersedes S[0-9]{3}' anywhere in teaches exempts); same URL different scope => W04 warning only
duplicateDetection.divergence: gate is URL-global; a same-URL/different-scope row is W04 under fleet but E04 under the gate

tier.scopedTo: scope cell; contract: A=primary/authoritative, B=strong secondary, C=lead only

scope.rule: free text, the claim/topic the tier applies to; participates in fleet URL+scope dedup

anchor.rule: exact section/heading/page/line plus revision (version, commit or publication date); never a bare homepage
anchor.gate: empty or '—' => bare_anchor finding (gate-only; fleet silent)

teaches.rejected: status=rejected REQUIRES teaches containing literal 'REJECTED:' AND 'flip:' => else rejected_without_flip; fleet only warns W02 when teaches length < 8
teaches.supersedes: correction rows open 'supersedes S0NN —'; gate dedup requires it at string start (/^supersedes S[0-9]{3,}\b/), fleet accepts it anywhere

status.trap: 'watch' is NOT a status (fleet header, E07); mined-with-dash-used-by is legal in fleet (W03 warning) but a hard gate finding mined_without_used_by

opened.gate: bad_opened if not ISO-date or < --since value; no future check
opened.fleet: E08 if not a valid date OR opened_epoch > today (future dates fail fleet only)
opened.trap: a future-dated row passes the lane gate but fails fleet E08

recheck.fleetAccepted: ISO date (calendar-validated) OR /^[0-9]+d$/ OR any symbolic cadence matching /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$/ (e.g. 'annual', 'on-change')
recheck.divergence: the only symbolic cadence both accept is 'on-release'; fleet-valid words like 'annual', 'quarterly', 'on-change' produce gate bad_recheck (E09). Contract v1 names only 90d, 180d, on-release
recheck.overdueMath: NNd due = opened + N days; ISO due = the date; symbolic is reported as cadence, never judged overdue

usedBy.shape: repo-relative paths separated by ',' or ';', or single '—' (U+2014 em dash) for none; a literally empty cell => used_by_missing/used_by_empty
gateChecks: every non-dash path on EVERY status (not only mined): escape (absolute, '..', backslash, NUL, drive-letter, UNC, symlink escape via nearest-real-ancestor realpath, ELOOP) => used_by_escape; stat failure or not-a-regular-file => used_by_missing; readable file that does not contain the row id under regex '(?<![A-Za-z0-9])<ID>(?![0-9])' => used_by_uncited (e.g. S030 must not be satisfied by 'S0300' or 'xS030'); unreadable => could_not_evaluate exit 2
fleetChecks: E11 missing used-by path on disk — only for status=mined rows, comma-split only, plain -e test, no citation or escape checking
W01: tier=C + mined + non-dash used-by (warning); W03: mined + used-by='—' (warning)
usedBy.divergence: gate checks queued/rejected used-by paths too and additionally demands the citing file literally contain the row id; a queued row pointing at a nonexistent path is fleet-clean but gate-failed

documentLevel: credential_patterns scanned over the WHOLE file: op://, BEGIN...PRIVATE KEY, ghp_*, AKIA*, xox[baprs]- => credential_material
no_rows finding when Registry yields zero row candidates
credential patterns and findings apply even inside prose sections

traps: em dash '—' (U+2014) is the only blank marker; ASCII '-', empty string, or 'none' are not (empty => used_by_empty; '-'/none => treated as real paths and fail)
'—' is invalid in anchor (bare_anchor) even though valid in used-by
cadence words: fleet accepts any symbolic word; gate accepts only 'on-release'; contract names only 90d/180d/on-release — use ISO date, NNd, or on-release

mined requires at least one real used-by path (gate hard finding; fleet only W03) — write mined rows only when the citing file already exists AND literally contains 'S0NN' with non-alphanumeric left boundary and non-digit right boundary
citing 'S0300' or 'xS030' does not satisfy the S030 citation regex
queued/rejected rows with a non-'—' used-by are existence+citation checked by the gate even though fleet ignores them
community kind can never be tier A (E10/tier_inflation)
rejected rows require teaches containing 'REJECTED:' and 'flip:'; keep the retained reason (fleet W02 needs >=8 chars)

duplicate normalized URL across rows: gate demands teaches starting 'supersedes S0NN' (position matters — mid-string does not exempt); fleet same-scope E04 exempts rejected rows unless a non-rejected row shares the scope
used-by paths must be repo-relative forward-slash paths inside root; absolute paths, '..', backslashes and symlink escapes fail
a future 'opened' date passes the gate but fails fleet E08; a date before a --since invocation fails the gate only
any '|' inside a cell breaks NF=13 (E01)
gate headings/rows are column-zero ('^## ', '^|'); a row indented 1-3 spaces is counted by fleet but invisible to the gate rowPattern — keep rows at column zero
no http(s) URL in source (own-work rows) skips all duplicate-URL logic; DOI-only sources likewise
registry must be a plain regular file — symlink, directory, or non-UTF8 => exit 2 could_not_evaluate

candidates.notes: S030-S036 ids are reservations only. Gate/row-shape validation below is by constraint reasoning, not by running the census on the live file. Actual row writes stay L1-only per PLAN and require this-round source opening per contract rule 1.

rows.checks: rowPattern ok; NF=13; kind/tier/status in vocab; opened==today<=fleet today; on-release in both vocabularies; used-by '—' legal for queued; no duplicate URL if URL new

rows.checks: same as S030; NNd cadence accepted by both validators
